title: LIVING BELOW
author: J. B. Coats
stanzas: Living below in this old sinful world Hardly a comfort can afford; Striving alone to face temptation sore, Where could I go but to the Lord?
Neighbors are kind, I love them ev'ry one, We get along in sweet accord; But when my soul needs manna from above Where could I go but to the Lord?
Life here is grand, with friends I love so dear, Comfort I get from God's own Word Yet when I face this chilling hand of death Where could I go but to the Lord?
chorus: Where could I go, O where could I go; Seeking a refuge for my soul? Needing a friend to help me in the end Where could I go but to the Lord
